objective: Preserve Kacha's deterministic local production kernel while adding governed capability breadth, reference-first intelligence, cost control, observability and reusable production packs.
inScope: Production flight recorder and deterministic replay
Clip-level media corpus search with diversity and truthful fallback
CLI, README, SKILL, architecture, tests and local install sync
outOfScope: Copying OpenMontage AGPL source or assets
Paid provider calls or automatic external uploads
Production deployment, public release, commit or push
Claiming real creator growth, audience outcome or device evidence
Replacing Kacha V7/V8 orchestration, Timeline IR, Studio or existing media index

architectureDecisions.decision: Capability decisions are code-enforced artifacts, not Markdown-only orchestration.
Hard privacy, license, availability, mode and cost gates run before ranking.
Unknown cost is never treated as free when a budget is enforced.
The flight recorder is a read-only observer and cannot mutate production state.
Reference analysis records source and rights boundaries and derives concepts, never a shot-for-shot copy plan.
Embedding unavailability must be labeled keyword_fallback; semantic quality cannot be implied.
Composition routing records chosen engine, exclusions and alternatives; it does not silently switch engines.

acceptance: Decision includes score breakdown and evidence freshness
Clip records have source identity and time ranges
Stages map to existing Kacha commands

completionBoundary: Complete means all locally executable deliverables and tests pass. Independent final review, external provider evidence, release/deploy and production outcomes remain separately gated.
